steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of formal project management education—but no prior work experience. If you hold a high school diploma or higher and are ready to formalize your project management knowledge, you meet the baseline requirement to begin.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format delivers the required contact hours in a focused timeframe, fitting the schedules of working professionals across Spartanburg's logistics, manufacturing, and healthcare sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After coursework completion, submit your application directly to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through the submission process to ensure accuracy and timely approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources and practice materials to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam when you feel ready, then sit for the assessment at an authorized testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) across the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Continuing education keeps your project management skills current and positions you for advancement.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
